meta.title: Baton Native
meta.description: Native DSH tools for dsh-baton: hand a task to an independent Harness session and get an evidence-backed result back when it ends. Adds baton_workspaces / baton_send / baton_status / baton_read / baton_cancel / baton_answer / baton_runs; the delegated session runs live in the sidebar and a finished run wakes the asking session once with changed files and check results.
